Start the scratch verify-reference command and wait for Reference capture armed.

decisionRules: If the exact previous rejected raw words recur, the tap-start change is insufficient for this direct-start condition; stop this candidate and do not ship it as a repair.

If no source, invalid setup, timing/buffer fault or incomplete capture occurs, classify it separately and do not infer sample identity.
